title: Melissa Cigarroa wins Laredo City Council District 3 in official canvass
excerpt: The Laredo City Council's official canvass confirms Melissa R. Cigarroa won re-election in District 3 with 3,157 votes, or 53.54 percent.
content:
The Laredo City Council has officially canvassed the November 3, 2026 election, and Melissa R. Cigarroa has won re-election to the District 3 council seat, defeating Clarissa "Claire" Cardenas and Michelle "Mimi" Winterroth.

Cigarroa received 3,157 votes, or 53.54 percent, to Cardenas's 1,590 votes, or 26.97 percent, and Winterroth's 1,149 votes, or 19.49 percent, according to the certified returns. A total of 5,896 votes were cast in the race.

The results are official. The City Council adopted the canvass on November 13, 2026, in Resolution 2026-R-275, based on the certified returns from the Webb County Elections Administrator. The mayor's race, in which no candidate won a majority, will be decided in a runoff on December 12, 2026, between Alyssa Cigarroa and Victor D. Trevino.

Sources:

  • City of Laredo — Resolution 2026-R-275, certified canvass returns, November 3, 2026 municipal election
  • City of Laredo — City Council Special Meeting, November 13, 2026
